digest.component_or_area: IAM and infrastructure access control for review-bot container
propositions: The review-bot container requires Bedrock credentials via the existing rebar-gerrit-instance-role instance profile but currently lacks any bedrock IAM permissions.

IMDS is reachable from review-bot containers on this host (AC1 IMDSv2 token PUT succeeds), enabling short-lived credential delivery through the instance role without requiring hop-limit changes or long-term API keys.

bedrock:Converse API calls from pydantic-ai's BedrockProvider authorize against bedrock:InvokeModel action (proven by runtime AccessDeniedException when only Converse actions were granted), not against bedrock:Converse as initially assumed.

The scoped IAM grant must authorize InvokeModel and InvokeModelWithResponseStream (not Converse/ConverseStream) on Claude foundation models and cross-region inference profiles using region-wildcarded ARNs to support both regional and global profile routing.
